dedupe_keys.name: datasets and benchmarks for airport ground movement research

description: This Zenodo record provides datasets and benchmark problems for research on airport ground movement, the routing and scheduling of aircraft taxiing between gates and runways. The data are derived from OpenStreetMap and from data supplied by Manchester Airport PLC, and the files are packaged as a single 3.3 MB zip archive published on 2015-06-18 by Alexander Brownlee of the University of Stirling. Coverage is the airports included in the archive. Access: a free download under the Open Database License. Caveats: the record's description is brief, the contents need to be inspected from the zip, and the data are over ten years old. It supports benchmarking of taxiway routing and scheduling algorithms, airport surface capacity studies and optimisation of ground operations, and complements the arrival trajectories dataset and the OpenSky Network records catalogued here.
name: Datasets and benchmarks for airport ground movement research
